accepted.quote: like Mr. Schweikert, I support the adoption of less lethal devices, including tasers, which can be used by law enforcement to reduce deadly engagement with civilians and be used by civilians as well to save lives.
accepted.rationale: Supports broader adoption of tasers by law enforcement and civilians to reduce deadly encounters.

accepted.quote: I just find it troubling that this bill would weaken the National Firearms Act under the auspices of supporting taser innovation when tasers aren't regulated under this section of the law.
accepted.rationale: Opposes creating a new loophole that would weaken National Firearms Act regulation of dangerous weapons.
